profiles.name: Single course
profiles.purpose: Onboard and build one course. The query layers narrow the context top-down (tier, levels, generic statements, shell, qualifiers) and four agent outcomes build the shell context the course learning outcomes come from. The run records the tiers and levels the course could feed into or build from, but builds only this one.
profiles.produces: One course at one tier and level band: AO-04 shell context statement, 6 course learning outcomes, then the course build.

steps.label: 1 Tier
steps.change: add a none option that defers to LEVEL(S)

steps.label: 2 Level(s)
steps.produces: one level or adjacent levels; auto from the tier bands when a tier is set
steps.open: the adjacency rule for grouped levels; L7 and L8 cross all tiers, and the tier bands do not list L8 yet

steps.label: FORK01.1 Qualification frameworks
steps.change: turn the reserved auto gate into a human select
inputs: catalogue/context/shared/cross-cutting.json frameworks (FHEQ, CQFW, FQHEIS within SCQF, QF-EHEA)

steps.label: FORK01.2 Universal and pathway benchmarks
steps.produces: 0 to 9 of the pathway's 9 generic benchmarks; 0 or 9 weight all nine equally

steps.label: AO-01 Generic competency attributes context
steps.produces: 6 generic benchmarks for the pathway: the generic basis for the course learning outcomes

steps.label: FORK02 Shell vs context slot
inputs: group: CAH1/CAH2 in tools/subject/core/vocab/cah.json + a group identity
specific: HECoS/CAH via tools/resolve-subject-benchmark.js, or a topic area
steps.produces: the shell: baseline, group (identity + HESA subjects) or specific (one subject or topic)
steps.open: group identities need the CMET course data tree

steps.label: AO-02 Context specific competency attributes context
steps.change: re-aim its product at context-specific competency attributes

steps.label: FORK03 Qualifiers
steps.change: raise the cap from 3 to 6 and add a fourth category, graduate competencies / capital
steps.produces: up to 6 qualifiers: pedagogical, professionally oriented, cross-cutting agendas, graduate competencies / capital
steps.open: the cap may vary: fixed per course or per category

steps.label: AO-03 Qualifier specific competency attributes context
inputs: the ingest each chosen qualifier points to
steps.produces: qualifier-specific competency attributes added to the shell context

steps.label: AO-04 ONB shell context statement
steps.produces: the shell context statement in academic prose, voice-linted: the product of ONB

profiles.name: Pathway distillation (all three tiers)
profiles.purpose: Distil a whole pathway for all three tiers at once. The 18 pathway statements (two evidence examples for each of the 9 capabilities, so 6 per tier) are evolved into 6 tiered outcomes per tier, boiled down to 3, then expanded back out to course outcomes. Distil and expand mirror each other, so every outcome traces back to its statements.
profiles.produces: For each of introductory, intermediate and advanced: 6 tiered outcomes, the 3 chosen, and the course outcomes expanded from them.

steps.label: The 18 pathway statements
steps.produces: the 18 statements, 6 per tier, with their capabilities, attribution and benchmark keys

steps.label: 6 tiered outcomes
inputs: tierReadings and the tier's section 16 verb band
the benchmarks keyed to the tier
steps.produces: 6 tiered outcomes per tier, each traced to its statements
steps.open: the evolve rule: one outcome per statement, or regrouped by complexity with the fuzzy tops co-tagged across adjacent tiers

steps.label: Boil down to 3
steps.produces: 3 outcomes per tier: agent suggests, human chooses

steps.label: Expand to course outcomes
steps.change: run once per tier from the 3, mirroring the distillation
steps.produces: course outcomes per tier, each traced to one of the 3
steps.open: how many course outcomes the 3 expand to
